frontmatter.title: Bounded Contexts and Service Granularity: Bridging Business Logic and Microservice Design
frontmatter.subheading: Mapping Bounded Contexts to Microservice Boundaries for Scalable Software Architecture
frontmatter.excerpt: Discover how bounded contexts from Domain-Driven Design (DDD) influence microservice granularity. Learn best practices for mapping business domains to services, explore common pitfalls, and see practical strategies for scalable software architecture.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
